The Spire Throne is the innermost area of Upper Blackrock Spire. It is accessed from the Furnace, which lies across a short stone bridge that spans the Lower Blackrock Spire. From here General Drakkisath rules the entirety of Blackrock Spire, supervised only by his lords in Blackwing Lair. The attunements to this raid dungeon, as well as that of Onyxia's Lair prior to patch 3.2.2, are both obtained by battling Drakkisath in this room.
Spikelash Dagger drops off Lady Vespira roaming throughout the Ruins of Mathystra in Darkshore.

Spiffworld is a YouTube phenomenon, very well known for his videos of World of Warcraft based on Jonathan Coulton and Paul & Storm songs. His highest viewed video, Jonathan Coulton's "Code Monkey" has received more than 5,000,000 views.
Spirit Candle is sold by Chapman during the Day of the Dead.
__NOTOC__ Spinestalker is a frost wyrm of the Frostbrood found inside the Frostwing Halls in Icecrown Citadel. Upon killing him and Rimefang, the queen of the Frostbrood, Sindragosa, will spawn.

The Spire connects the Plagueworks, the Crimson Hall and Frostwing Halls in the middle level of Icecrown Citadel surrounding the Frozen Throne. Val'kyr Heralds circle the area, patrolling for intruders. At its base, Lord Marrowgar stands vigil, waiting to kill any intruders who dare attempt to enter his master's sanctum.
Spire Frostwyrms are frost wyrms found along the way to the gunships Icecrown Citadel.
Spiked Wooden Plank drops from Maggot Eye which is found in a house at Garren's Haunt in Tirisfal Glades.
__NOTOC__ Spiny Raptors are raptors located in Raptor Rise on the Lost Isles. They come in colors of green, red, blue and black.
Spiny Raptor Eggs are looted from Raptor Eggs on the Lost Isles.
Spiketooth Eels are eels that swims on the floor fn the Silver Tide Trench in Shimmering Expanse.
Spire Spider are crystal spiders found in Blackrock Spire. They can be tamed by hunters. When a Spire Spider dies, four Spire Spiderlings will spawn from its corpse.
Spikemender Shoulderplates are a quest reward from A Standard Day for Azrajar.

This item is a quest reward from This Means WAR (Wild Arachnid Roundup), which begins with Nathaniel Dumah in the Western Plaguelands. The mace looks like a frying pan, using the same model as Unidentified Cooking Utensil
Spidery Sundial is a common archaeology artifact that requires 45 Nerubian Archaeology Fragments to complete. Up to two keystones may be used to complete this artifact.

__NOTOC__ The Spiked Gauntlets of Anvilrage is a common archaeology artifact requiring 45 Dwarf Archaeology Fragments to solve. Up to two Dwarf Rune Stone keystones may be used to aid solving this artifact.
Spike Coilee is an herbalism vendor located in the neutral town of Bogpaddle in the Swamp of Sorrows. He shares a shop with Mitch Yostpaddle on the west side of town.
The Spinescale Matriarch has set up a lair on the road between Winterspring and Doom's Vigil.

Spinal Healing Injector is an tinker enchant (only usable by players with Engineering) to belts. It can be used to increase the mana gained from using a Mythical Healing Potion. As such, this is by no means a "free" healing potion - it will only work if there's a Mythical Healing Potion in the player's inventory to consume. This also means it triggers and is affected by the potion cooldown.
Spire Gargoyles are gargoyles found along the way to the gunships Icecrown Citadel.
Spire Minions are ghouls found along the way to the gunships Icecrown Citadel.
Spirestone Battle Mages are ogre mages found in Blackrock Spire.
Spirestone Ogre Magi are ogre mages found in Blackrock Spire.
Spiked Tentacles are tentacles located in the Throne of the Apocalypse in the Bastion of Twilight.

Spirit Binders is an scroll located at at the Terrace of Ten Thunders in the Jade Forest. Interacting with this scroll is one of the requirements of the Pandaria exploration achievement The Dark Heart of the Mogu.
__NOTOC__ Spirit Darters are faerie dragons found in the Jade Forest.

Spirit-Sage Gaoquan is a pandaren located in Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest. He is the oldest member of the monastery, seeing many elders come and go. During the banquet, he was walking on a table.

Spire of Solitude is a small spire in northwest Jade Forest notable for having the Cave of Words inside it. The Fertile Copse is to the north, the Path of Enlightenment circles the spire and continues southeast, the Circle of Stone is just to the east, and Exclamation Point and Tigers' Wood are to the south.
Spineshell Pincers are crabs found into the Glimmerdeep Gorge in Shimmering Expanse.
Spiny Rock Crabs are crabs found at the coast of Theramore in Dustwallow Marsh.
__NOTOC__ Spinescale Hammerheads are hammerhead sharks swimming in Seabrush in Abyssal Depths.
Spike Spencer is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft and its various expansions.

__NOTOC__ Spinefish are malformed abominations from Pandaria, created by the sha presence. No part of the fish is edible, but they do have properties that are very interesting to alchemists. The alphas of the species are one of Pandaria's deadliest predators. The big ones are terrifying creatures that often display cannibalistic behavior, apparently out of pure aggression.
Spindly Bloodfeathers drop from Glade Hunters and Glade Sprinters in the Gilded Fan in the Valley of the Four Winds.
__NOTOC__ Spiny Lizards are lizards located in Durotar and Orgrimmar.
__NOTOC__ Spiky Lizards are lizards located in the Badlands and Silithus.

Spirit Bottles drop from Shan'ze Spiritclaws at the Terrace of Ten Thunders in Jade Forest.
The Spirit Bottles are provided as an objective for Back to Nature. Using it in Tideview Thicket summons Raging Beast Spirits or Peaceful Beast Spirits.

The Spinefish Alpha can be fished up from inland sha-infested waters in Kun-Lai Summit and the Dread Wastes. This is one of three rare fish that Nat Pagle is looking for and will provide 500 reputation with his personal faction down at Anglers Wharf in Krasarang Wilds. It has a slightly higher drop rate compared to the other two rare fish, as the other items fished up from sha-infested waters are not as valuable compared to regular freshwater and saltwater fish.
The Spirit Essence of Varatus drops from Varatus the Conqueror in Kun-Lai Summit.
Spirit-Bound Sentries are Zandalari golems found at Conqueror's Terrace on the Isle of Thunder.
__NOTOC__ Spirit Flayers are undead trolls in the Throne of Thunder phased into the spirit world that cannot be harmed that will knock back players, and can so doing throw players off the bridge.
Spider Venom Leggings are a quest reward from Dark Vessels (Alliance) and Dark Vessels (Horde).
Spinz Shredbark is a goblin engineering vendor located at Irontree Cavern in Felwood.

__NOTOC__ The Spiky Collar drops from the Big Bad Wolf in Karazhan.

__NOTOC__ The Spineclaw Crab drops from the Monstrous Spineclaw, rare crab on the Timeless Shore of the Timeless Isle.
Spinecrawl is a rare ravager that can be found at the very back of the Irontree Cavern in Felwood.

The Spires of Arak storyline is the level-up experience in the Spires of Arak. Players are led here from their faction outposts in Talador. The Adherents of Rukhmar are waging a war of extermination of the cursed arakkoa, and one of the first things that players see is the Skyreach superweapon obliterating Veil Akraz! The storyline tracking achievement is called Between Arak and a Hard Place and has nine chapters. The chapters are somewhat interleaved, as the zone storyline does not play out linearly. Eventually, the player will recieve the quest News from Nagrand, which leads them to

The Spirit Festival is an annual festival celebrated by the pandaren of the Wandering Isle to honor the memory of Liu Lang. It is considered the most important celebration of the year. During one year's festival, the lineup included a musical number by Strongbo's pandowan students. One of the participants was Li Li Stormstout, who ruined the event by falling asleep behind the curtains, to the embarrassment of her father Chon Po. This led to an argument between Li Li and her father in which she argued that the festival was just a show to the people of the Wandering Isle and that they had forgotten the true lessons of Liu Lang, in turn leading to Chon Po forbidding Li Li from entering the isla

:Are you looking for Trey Lightforge or Remains of Trey Lightforge? The Spirit of Trey Lightforge was a human ghost found in Felwood. He spawned near the end of the quest Rescue From Jaedenar.

The Spitelash naga shows the greatest presence to the surface world. They have claimed Eldarath in Azshara for their own. Warlord Krellian rules over the invasion with an iron fist. It is rumored that Lady Sesspira sometimes take presence to the ruins to overview the actions of Krellian, whose leadership over the community is limited, like those of all male naga. Azshara was home to rare Enchanted Coral (Classic), which the Spitelash were drawn to. After the Cataclysm, the naga and the goblins of the Bilgewater Cartel waged a full-blown war at the ruins. The area is now led by Lord Kassarus. During the Burning Legion's invasion, the ruins fell under the Legion's control, seeking to use it as

Spirit Rock is a place sacred to the shaman of the Horde. It is located in the hills high above the Valley of Trials in Durotar, and is accessible from the Hidden Path leading up to it. Aspiring shaman used to drink a sapta near the rock in order to commune with the earth.
Spiteflayer is a rare two-headed vulture found in the Blasted Lands.

Spirit Rise is situated to the northwest of the central bluff and is the center for shamanistic studies in Thunder Bluff. The Skychaser tribe holds great influence here. Below the surface of the mesa are the steamy Pools of Vision. It connects to lower rise and middle rise by separate rope bridges. There is also a zeppelin dock that players can use to travel to Orgrimmar.
The Spirit of Zanza was a quest reward from Zanza's Potent Potables.
Spirit Shards are a PvP currency dropped by bosses in the Auchindoun instances when the player's faction controls the five Spirit Towers in the Bone Wastes.

Spirit of Kirith is a Forsaken ghost quest giver located in Serpent's Coil in the Blasted Lands. The Spirit of Kirith spawned at the death of Kirith the Damned. He has been missing since the Cataclysm, presumably having finally found peace in death.
Spirit of the Faerie Dragon is a quest reward from Weapons of Spirit.

__NOTOC__ The Spirit of the Vale is an earth elemental quest giver located at the Sacred Grove in Azuremyst Isle. He is the spirit of the earth elemental, angered by the unbalance in nature when the Exodar crashed.
This is one of the Blasted Lands buff quests. It rewards characters with a potion giving +25 stamina for a period of 60 minutes.
Spiritual Guidance is a priest holy talent that increases the healing and spell damage a priests does by a percentage of their total spirit.

Giant succubus, able to Mind Control. Places a debuff on random party member that increases their threat generated by 500%. She is also immune to taunt, so cloth wearers should avoid generating any aggro for the duration of the debuff.

The Spirit of Silverpine is one of two sunken Blackwater Raiders frigates located in the Drowned Reef in the coast of the Arathi Highlands. The other ship is named Maiden's Folly and lies east of the Spirit of Silverpine. Both ships were part of an expedition, along with a third ship, the Harbinger, in search of a lost elven treasure. When the ships were signaled by Shakes O'Breen to come dock at their location, the sea rumbled, the tides lowered, and the two ships crashed into the reef.

The Spirit of Maraudos is the ghostly Maraudos roaming the Wicked Grotto in Maraudon.

Spiteful Apparitions can be found in the Forge of Souls. They appear out of thin air and attack a random party member, then disappear. It is very difficult to kill them before they use their attack and despawn.
The Spirit of Bridenbrad is his soul redeemed by A'dal and his Naaru promising him "paradise eternal".

Spiritwalker's Grace is a shaman class talent that allows all spells to be cast while moving, when normally you would only be able to use instant cast spells without having to stop. It is unique in that it not only off the global cooldown but can even be used while casting another spell, allowing you to start moving in the middle of casting.
The Spitescale are a group of naga found at the Echo Isles in Durotar. Led by Zar'jira the Sea Witch, they battled the Darkspear trolls in attempt to take over the Echo Isles.
The Spirit of the Tiger was the form taken by the player during the quest Lady Of Da Tigers.
Spitescale Breastplate is a quest reward from No More Mercy.
Spitelash Stormfuries are naga found in Ravencrest Monument in Azshara.

The Spirit of Lo'Gosh is an image of Goldrinn that appears for Horde adventurers after Lycanthoth is killed in the Maw of Lycanthoth in Mount Hyjal. He can also be summoned using the Totem of Lo'Gosh.

The Spirit of Goldrinn is an image of Goldrinn that appears for Alliance adventurers after Lycanthoth is killed in the Maw of Lycanthoth in Mount Hyjal. He can also be summoned using the Totem of Goldrinn.
The Spirit of Thaurissan is one of the Dark Iron Thanes located in the Athenaeum in Blackwing Descent. He is the spirit of the infamous Sorcerer-Thane Thaurissan.

__NOTOC__ The Spirit of Moltenfist is one of the Dark Iron Thanes located in the Athenaeum in Blackwing Descent. In life, Moltenfist's avarice was legendary, even among Dark Iron kings. He owned a jeweled goblet.

__NOTOC__ The Spirit of Corehammer is one of the Dark Iron Thanes found in the Athenaeum in Blackwing Descent. He is the spirit of Thane Corehammer. In life, he wore a winged helm whose large size indicates that he was either enormous or just enormously fat.

__NOTOC__ The Spirit of Burningeye is one of the Dark Iron Thanes found in the Athenaeum in Blackwing Descent. He is the spirit of Iron Thane Burningeye, who delighted in battle and was known to wield a pair of great warhammers. The Bracers of the Burningeye are named after the thane.

__NOTOC__ The Spirit of Angerforge is one of the Dark Iron Thanes located in the the Athenaeum in Blackwing Descent. He is the spirit of Thane Angerforge. The Angerforge family has a long lineage in Dark Iron history, and General Angerforge is one of the thane's descendants. The Fury of Angerforge is named after the thane.
Spiritual Barrier is a quest reward from Ambushed! (Western Plaguelands).
Spirit Twister is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating 20 Twisted Spirits within 15 seconds during the Jin'do encounter in Zul'Gurub on Heroic difficulty.
The Spiritguard Drape is a random drop from mobs in Zul'Gurub.
During The Fallen Chieftain, the Spirit of Cairne is called by the ancestors to join them in the afterlife, and leaves his dead body on his pyre.
__NOTOC__ Spirit of Kalytha is a night elf ghost seen during Memories of the Dead.
The Spirit of Agamaggan is a ghost located in Razorfen Kraul, seeking the death of to redeem his children.
Spiritwalker's Vestments is the tier 13 restoration shaman set.
Spiritwalker's Battlegear is the tier 13 enhancement shaman set.
Spirits of the North are arcane wyrms found around the Nexus in the Borean Tundra.
Spirits of the Flame are mobs in the Firelands that spawns when Majordomo Staghelm casts Leaping Flames.

Spiritsong Lake can be found just east of Honeydew Village in north-central Jade Forest. Along its eastern edge is what appears to be a small shrine. Turtles inhabit its waters and shores, and spirits similar in appearance to the ancient spirit, Shu, float along the surface.
Spiteful Spirits are yaungol ghosts located at Hatred's Vice in Townlong Steppes.
